assumptions: Estimated jointly with the rational-expectations return equation by native Stata mlexp under an explicit independent-error conditional Gaussian likelihood with separate positive constant variances; the paper reports iterative weighted nonlinear least squares but does not disclose the weights or cross-equation error restriction.
Follows the Table 2 equation and parameter list with a shared omega0; the body equation on p. 13 stars the return intercept, but Table 2 on p. 14 does not and lists one omega0.

Uses local Compustat/CRSP source vintages, dated unique CCM links, documented supported currency conversion for mixed reporting histories, and a reconstructed approximate target size-decile assignment from the provider-documented annual MSIX convention. A first-cap fallback is usable only before or in the holding-start month; a later-month first cap does not assign a decile retroactively.
Uses a common complete system sample and pooled strict 1st/99th percentile BKLG trimming; the local realized N is compared with the source 21,891 without tuning.

Structural return parameters are identified under the same explicit independent-error conditional Gaussian likelihood; unrestricted cross-equation covariance would confound beta1 with the conditional covariance term, so nlsur convergence alone is insufficient.

Checks the unrestricted seven mean parameters against the equivalent forecast OLS and conditional return OLS reparameterization on the realized common sample, and verifies both positive error standard deviations.
Uses two directly estimated nested likelihoods for omega1=omega1* and omega2=omega2*; no unweighted SSR ratio is presented as an LR test.

Compounds CRSP MSIX value-weighted monthly total returns for the annual size decile as the benchmark, while the paper describes a mean-return buy-and-hold portfolio. Prior calendar-year-end target deciles are approximate and may differ from fiscal-year-end formation or vendor membership. A first-cap fallback observed after the holding-start month is treated as unavailable for the target rather than backdated.

limitations: The local annual Compustat and CRSP vintages differ from the authors’ stated 2000 tapes; the reported source sample count is a comparison point.

The paper’s iterative weighting function and cross-equation error covariance restriction are not specified. Independent-error conditional Gaussian maximum likelihood is an identified best-effort departure from the source estimator.

CRSP MSIX is value-weighted and annually rebalanced, while the paper describes a mean-return buy-and-hold decile portfolio; reconstructed target ranks lack vendor dated membership assignments, and calendar-year-end formation may differ from fiscal-year-end formation.

Mixed reporting histories use ratio-specific common-USD translation where the required daily asset/OB rates and statement-month EXRAT12M IB rates are positive, unique, and available. Unsupported mixed ratios remain unavailable; same-currency ratios stay native.

CRSP MSIX target membership is reconstructed approximately. A first-cap fallback is used only when its date is before or in the holding-start month; a later-month first cap does not supply a target decile for already elapsed months.
